text:
Mia: FYI customer Nordica GmbH has an invoice stuck on HOLD because the VAT exemption check failed when they uploaded a resale certificate.

billing-bot: Invoice #INV-0001243 placed on HOLD by tax-checker v2. Reason: reverse_charge pending, evidence mismatch.

Jonas: Can you paste the webhook payload that vendor portal sent to tax-checker?

Mia: Pasting payload we received from vendor portal:
```
{
  "company": "Nordica GmbH",
  "vat_id": "DE123456789",
  "country_code": "DE",
  "cert_type": "resale_cert",
  "file_id": "abc123"
}
```

Priya: I can repro this — vendor-portal mapping changed to emit ISO3 codes but fallback isn't working. Our tax-checker expects ISO3 (DEU) and rejects ISO2 (DE).

Oliver: I remember that change — commit 8f3a2c on 2026-02-12. Quick fix: accept ISO2 as a fallback, then emit a warning to logs.

Mia: Customer already escalated to their finance lead, wants ETA. They also uploaded the signed resale cert PDF and a screenshot of the VIES response.

Jonas: Compliance check: can we manually verify and clear the hold while we patch? We need either VIES green or manual reviewer sign-off attached to invoice.

Priya: Repro steps:
1) Upload resale cert via vendor portal UI
2) Vendor portal sends webhook to /tax-check/webhook with payload above
3) tax-checker runs map_country(code) -> fails for 'DE' and returns 400

Logs:
```
ERROR tax-checker: invalid country code 'DE' for vat_id DE123456789 - map lookup failed
WARN vendor-portal: emitting country_code=DE after recent mapping change
```

Oliver: I've created a branch allow_iso2_fallback and a tiny change to map ISO2->ISO3 using our country table if ISO3 missing. PR: https://git.redwood/dev/allow_iso2_fallback (small)

Mia: Customer asked for a manual resolution now — can somebody approve exemption manually so payment isn't blocked?

Jonas: I'll manually approve pending legal review. Action: mark invoice exempt, attach evidence (resale_cert abc123 + VIES screenshot), reviewer Jonas. I'll note it in invoice history.

billing-bot: EXEMPTION_APPROVED by Jonas at 2129999400. Invoice #INV-0001243 updated.

Priya: Deploying hotfix to vendor-portal mapping and tax-checker fallback now, ETA ~30m. Rolling update with health checks.

Oliver: Rollback plan: if errors spike, revert mapping flag and restore strict validation. Monitor error rate and reconciliation queue.

Mia: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll tell Nordica finance we've cleared the hold and share the evidence request for their records. Will follow up once payment clears.

Jonas: Leaving a note for audits: manual override due to webhook mapping regression. Ticket #SUP-123456 attached.

Mia: Closing loop — will re-open if anything else pops up.
